reading.title: Playing a Younger Role
reading.intro_zh: 这篇短文不复述 Jennifer 的舞台故事，而是换到学校短片拍摄：真实的学生和表演中的 role 不一样，costume、声音和动作帮助观众相信角色。重点回收 actress、stage、appear、bright、in spite of this、grown up。
passage: Next month, our class will make a short film on the classroom stage for the school festival, and Mei will take part in it. Mei is not a professional actress; she is the tallest student in our group, and she must be at least fourteen, but her role is a lost little child. In spite of this, she appears on screen as a six-year-old because she changes her voice, walks slowly, and wears a bright yellow costume with white stockings. At first, some students laughed, but after rehearsal everyone believed the role. Mei said the costume helped her stop thinking like herself and start thinking like the child. When our teacher asked whether it was hard to act so young, Mei smiled and said, "It must be terrible to be grown up all the time!"

questions.question: What role does Mei have to play?
options: A theatre teacher.
A lost little child.
A professional actress.
A costume designer.
questions.explanation_zh: 短文说 Mei 的 role is a lost little child。

questions.question: How is Mei's real identity different from the role?
options: She is at least fourteen, but she appears as a six-year-old child.
She is six years old, but she plays a grown-up teacher.
She is a professional actress, but she plays a student.
She is short, but she plays the tallest student.
questions.explanation_zh: 文中对比了 Mei must be at least fourteen 和 appears on screen as a six-year-old。

questions.question: Why is Mei's costume important?
options: It helps her win a fashion prize.
It makes everyone forget the film.
It helps her think like the child and helps others believe the role.
It proves that short socks are always required.
questions.explanation_zh: 短文说 costume helped her stop thinking like herself and start thinking like the child。

questions.question: What did everyone believe after rehearsal?
options: Mei was really six years old.
The role in the short film.
The school festival was cancelled.
Costumes were not useful.
questions.explanation_zh: 短文写道 after rehearsal everyone believed the role，不是相信 Mei 真的变小了。

questions.question: What lesson idea does the passage show?
options: A performer can appear as someone different from their real self.
Only young children can act in school films.
A bright costume is more important than acting.
Being grown up is always terrible.
questions.explanation_zh: 整篇强调真实身份和角色身份不同，演员可以 appear as someone else。

writing.intro_zh: 今天抓 Lesson 17 的五个核心句式：must be at least 表示强推测，In spite of this 写现实和角色的反差，appears ... as ... 写角色身份，will have to 写未来要求，it must be terrible to 写带玩笑感的强烈判断。

patterns.title: must be at least ...
patterns.source: She must be at least thirty-five years old.
patterns.focus_zh: must be at least 表示根据线索做强推测：一定至少是某个年龄、数量或程度。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：根据声音、身高、经验或行为，推测某人至少多少岁或至少有多少经验。
patterns.sample: The new actor must be at least twenty because he drives to school.
patterns.tip_zh: 这里的 must be 不是“必须”，而是“一定是”；at least 后面接数字或程度。

patterns.title: In spite of this, ...
patterns.source: In spite of this, she often appears on the stage as a young girl.
patterns.focus_zh: 用 In spite of this 写“虽然前面是真的，但后面出现了一个反差”。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：写一个演员真实情况和舞台角色之间的反差。
patterns.sample: In spite of this, she still appears cheerful on the stage.
patterns.tip_zh: this 指前文已经说过的事实；逗号后面写出乎意料的结果。

patterns.title: appears ... as ...
patterns.source: She often appears on the stage as a young girl.
patterns.focus_zh: appear as 用来说明表演中“呈现为什么角色”。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：写某人在短片、舞台、配音或 cosplay 中扮演什么角色。
patterns.sample: He appears in the video as a tired old king.
patterns.tip_zh: as 后面接角色身份，比如 a detective, a robot, a young prince。

patterns.title: will have to ...
patterns.source: Jennifer will have to take part in a new play soon.
patterns.focus_zh: will have to 表示将来因为安排、任务或角色要求而必须做某事。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：写你或同学为了一个角色、演出或比赛将不得不做什么准备。
patterns.sample: I will have to wear a dark coat for the detective role.
patterns.tip_zh: have to 后面接动词原形；可以写服装、排练、说话方式或动作要求。

patterns.title: it must be terrible to ...
patterns.source: Darling, it must be terrible to be grown up!
patterns.focus_zh: 这个句式用 must be 表达一种强烈感受或玩笑式判断。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：用轻松、戏剧化的语气说某件事一定很糟糕或很难。
patterns.sample: It must be terrible to forget your lines before the show.
patterns.tip_zh: 这句话可以很夸张、很戏剧化；注意 it must be terrible to 后面接动词原形。
